name: Favorite Pie
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Mash 6 stewed apples and while hot stir in a tablespoon butter
When cool add the beaten yolks of 4 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup cream and juice of one lemon
Line pie tins with good crust and fill with above mixture
Bake in a quick oven and spread the beaten whites of the eggs sweetened a little over top
Place in oven and brown lightly

source.originalInstructions:
1. Mash 6 stewed apples and while hot stir in a tablespoon butter
2. When cool add the beaten yolks of 4 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup cream and juice of one lemon
3. Line pie tins with good crust and fill with above mixture
4. Bake in a quick oven and spread the beaten whites of the eggs sweetened a little over top
5. Place in oven and brown lightly
